title: HoneyStick Ripper eRig Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
Next Generation Electric Dab Rig

The HoneyStick Ripper e-Rig is a revolutionary portable electric dab rig that combines the benefits of traditional dabbing with the precision of electronic temperature control. This innovative device is designed for both dabs and dry herbs, offering a superior vaping experience.

Key Features:
Portable Design: Easy to take on-the-go.
Borosilicate Glass Water Bubbler: Ensures crisp, chilled, and smooth vapor.
Robust Metallic Base: Houses a powerful 4000mAh battery.
Variable Temperature Control: Allows for precise heat adjustments.
Concentrate Implement: Optimizes material handling.
Cleaning Swabs Included: Maintains cleanliness for repeated use.

Specifications:
Type: Electric Dab Rig
Material: Robust Metallic Base (with glass components)
Battery Capacity: 4000mAh
Temperature Range: Variable (specific range not provided)

Important Safety Information: Not intended for smoking tobacco. Use with proper vaping equipment and follow manufacturer guidelines.

This advanced HoneyStick Ripper e-Rig offers a superior vaping experience by combining portability, precision temperature control, and high-capacity battery life. It’s perfect for those who want to elevate their dabbing and dry herb vaping sessions with a modern, user-friendly device.
